name: peek-before-eradicate
description: G7 (John's case): cart runs ahead of eradicate along eradicate's own way into the Apartments corridor and stops at about 10 s in Lokier's line from Truck, where the recording has Lokier headshot eradicate at 12.75 s (cart's own recording is still in Back Alley then, 7 s from the corridor). cart never fires. He is off script for Lokier, who is scoped on that corridor, so Lokier goes LIVE and shoots at him within a human reaction time; the scheduled window encounter is over. The survivors carry on and rejoin their recording where it still makes sense.
